blocks.content: The data structures we learned up until this point—lists, stacks, queues, and linked lists—are linear data structures.
To recap, in a linear data structure:

items: Each element has previous and next elements, except for the first and last elements.
Elements can be traversed in a single run.

blocks.content: Linear data structures are powerful and versatile. However, they have certain limitations, which we will explore next.
